Plan a complete causal story from the request and immutable seed. Return one compact-story-plan.v4 JSON object matching output_schema, with no Markdown/outside prose. Be concise. Never regenerate a fixture, seed/canon/topology, state hashes, route metadata, coverage triples or projected spatial states.

Choose meaningful decisions and consequences, using established abilities/resources/rules. Physical truth is not initial character knowledge: show discovery. Respect the deadline. Do not assume perfect repair or success unless requested. A resolution must be earned by events, not declared by metadata.

Each event's first predicate is its principal actor/action/target; additional predicates describe explicit details. required_observer is a DECLARATION of who must observe/acknowledge that action. Code supplies the required OBSERVE predicate if absent; do not duplicate technical observer protocol. A visible physical fact is ordinarily DIRECT_OBSERVATION and needs no separate clue. Only if the plan actually calls for an additional physical demonstration, declare physical_clue with its subject (who shows it) and target (the established thing shown). Code supplies SHOW_PHYSICAL_CLUE. Do not output separate_physical_clue_required. Do not invent clues/items/lore/rules. These generated predicates are requirements for later writer/guard evidence, not automatic satisfaction.

Evidence provenance is derived from evidence_mode. resulting_state contains only explicit consequences: complete replacement values at absolute JSON pointers into existing characters' condition/inventory/knowledge/relationships, existing objects' state, or world fields excluding rules/spatial. Never write revision/route metadata, entity locations, closures, spatial state, new entities, overlapping paths or incompatible intermediate values in one scene. Effects describe the scene's final values; planning only projects state.

Each scene has narrative_purpose/objective/turn. goal_bindings maps each to a list of EVENT IDs; choosing an event includes its complete predicate specification. Every event needs a goal binding. ordered_dependencies is CURRENT-SCENE ONLY: both anchors must name events in this same scene. Route sequence already orders different scenes; never point to another scene. ordered_dependencies has before/after event anchors (event_id, optional predicate_id for a specific sub-action; otherwise the principal action). Code expands coverage, so sub-actions remain covered.

spatial_operations declares id, a literal kind from capabilities.allowed_spatial_kinds, subject (established tracked entity or declared group), target, event_id and applicable existing edge_id/constraint_id. No predicate_id: code reuses/derives the exact physical predicate from this declaration. No movement is guessed from narrative verbs; carrying an object can declare MOVE of that object plus explicit character moves as needed. No new entities/locations/passages. LOCATE is not available: all seed entities are already tracked. Discovering an existing object, reading evidence or learning its location is a narrative event with knowledge/state consequences, not a spatial establishment. MOVE/JOINT_MOVE are unavailable if topology has no edges. BLOCK/RELEASE are unavailable if the seed has no declared access constraints. JOINT_MOVE needs a declared group and established shared hold from a previous scene. Spatial events must permit direct evidence.

Resolve existing open threads/obligations explicitly using kind/id and an evidence predicate reference in the resolving scene. Code preserves details and sets SATISFIED only for declared resolutions. Resolve all by the final scene. Optional existing-state preconditions are checked, not repaired. Bind every request requirement to a real scene/event/predicate with a rationale. Use the exact requested scene count and unique safe scene IDs. Optional defaults may be omitted; no unresolved questions. Existing structural/semantic guards still check the expanded proposal. Rewrite findings point into the expanded design: fix their source in this compact proposal.

Scene/route IDs must match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}; never use paths or spaces.
Return exactly one valid JSON object. Do not include Markdown fences or prose outside the JSON object.
